title: **The Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum Heist**

scenes.text: On March 18, 1990, two men disguised as police officers stole 13 works of art from the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum in Boston.
The stolen works included paintings by Rembrandt, Vermeer, and Degas.

scenes.label: Unsolved Heist
scenes.text: The heist remains one of the most famous unsolved art thefts in history.
Follow for a new cold case every day.
